identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a professional-grade, mobile-first CAD Finance Suite that feels like a 'Dark Control Room'—precise, secure, and aesthetically superior to generic SaaS dashboards.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Cyberpunk utility.
Emotion First: The user should feel 'In Control' and 'Secure'.
Content is King: Data is the hero; UI is the stage.
Zoom In: Focus on the numbers that matter (Net Worth, Tax Liability).
Negative Space: Don't clutter; let the data breathe.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to the <head> of index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the new font families (Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) and the custom color palette.
3. SETUP SHADCN: When using Shadcn components, override the default 'radius' to '0.5rem' or '0.75rem' (rounded-lg/xl) but keep it consistent.
4. MOBILE FIRST: Always design the mobile view first. Use 'hidden md:block' for desktop-only elements.
5. DARK MODE DEFAULT: Force dark mode class on the html/body tag. Do not implement a light mode toggle unless requested later.
6. USE LUCIDE ICONS: Use lucide-react for all iconography.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
8. SISTER MODULE: Use a distinct accent color (e.g., Violet/Purple) for the 'Sister Module' to visually differentiate it from the main Finance Dashboard.
9. NO GRADIENT TEXT: Avoid gradient text for accessibility; use gradients only for borders or subtle backgrounds.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Micro-animations: Hover states, active states, and entrance animations are mandatory.
Spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 where you'd normally use p-4.
Glassmorphism: Use it sparingly (Nav, Toasts, Modals) - don't overuse it on content cards.
Charts: Keep them simple and legible. Don't use 3D charts.
